preview.tournamentOverview: Sedgefield Country Club rewards ball-striking over distance, with approach play carrying the heaviest weight at 8% and total strokes-gained at 9%. The tight fairways and firm greens place a premium on accuracy and proximity control rather than raw power. This final regular-season event sets the final FedEx Cup Playoffs field, making every stroke critical for bubble players.
preview.modelExplainer: Approach play 8%) and total strokes-gained 9%) dominate the model, followed by around-the-green work 2%) and off-the-tee accuracy 4%). Putting 9%) and driving accuracy 7%) receive lower emphasis, reflecting Sedgefield's scoring profile. The model therefore prioritizes players who rank high in approach and total SG while still crediting short-game stability.
preview.pickApproach: We tier bets by model rank versus power rank gaps, targeting players inside the top 10 whose course fit exceeds baseline expectations. Exposure is capped at 1-2 units per golfer, with larger stakes reserved for the clearest model-to-market discrepancies.

article.title: Wyndham Championship Model Targets: Young, Matsuyama, Hisatsune Lead Sedgefield Field
article.dek: Tournament model ranks Cameron Young first, Hideki Matsuyama second, and Ryo Hisatsune third for the 147-player Wyndham field at Sedgefield Country Club.
article.introduction: The tournament model places Cameron Young at rank 1 with 574 SG Total, Hideki Matsuyama at rank 2 with 197 SG Total, and Ryo Hisatsune at rank 3 with 238 SG Total. Course weights emphasize SG Approach at 8% and SG Total at 9%. All three players carry top-10 model ranks and skipped the Scottish Open.

sections.heading: Tournament Overview
sections.body: The Wyndham Championship at Sedgefield Country Club features a 147-player field with course weights of SG Approach 8%, SG Total 9%, and SG Around-the-Green 2%. The model ranks Cameron Young first, Hideki Matsuyama second, and Ryo Hisatsune third.

sections.heading: Course Fit
sections.body: Sedgefield rewards approach play and total strokes gained. Cameron Young posts 499 SG Approach and 574 SG Total. Hideki Matsuyama records 635 SG Approach and 197 SG Total. Ryo Hisatsune shows 576 SG Approach and 238 SG Total.

sections.heading: Model Strength vs Power Rank
sections.body: Cameron Young holds model rank 1 and power rank 6. Hideki Matsuyama sits at model rank 2 and power rank 16. Ryo Hisatsune ranks model 3 and power 20. Each player's model rank exceeds their power rank.

sections.heading: Post-Open Workload
sections.body: Cameron Young, Hideki Matsuyama, and Ryo Hisatsune each have zero tracked rounds in the post-Open window. All three skipped the Scottish Open.

sections.heading: FedExCup Standing
sections.body: Cameron Young enters at FedExCup rank 3. Hideki Matsuyama sits at FedExCup rank 24. Ryo Hisatsune holds FedExCup rank 42. All three remain inside the top 50.

sections.heading: Crossover Research Angles
sections.body: Cameron Young combines model rank 1, power rank 6, and skipped Scottish Open. Hideki Matsuyama pairs model rank 2, power rank 16, and skipped Scottish Open. Ryo Hisatsune links model rank 3, power rank 20, and skipped Scottish Open.

sections.heading: Outright Targets
